scripts.build:contracts: mkdir -p .foundry-home .foundry-cache && if [ -x .foundry-solc/solc-0.8.24 ]; then HOME=$PWD/.foundry-home forge build --root contracts --cache-path $PWD/.foundry-cache --config-path $PWD/contracts/foundry.toml --use $PWD/.foundry-solc/solc-0.8.24; else HOME=$PWD/.foundry-home forge build --root contracts --cache-path $PWD/.foundry-cache --config-path $PWD/contracts/foundry.toml; fi
scripts.test:contracts: mkdir -p .foundry-home .foundry-cache && if [ -x .foundry-solc/solc-0.8.24 ]; then HOME=$PWD/.foundry-home forge test --root contracts --cache-path $PWD/.foundry-cache --config-path $PWD/contracts/foundry.toml --use $PWD/.foundry-solc/solc-0.8.24; else HOME=$PWD/.foundry-home forge test --root contracts --cache-path $PWD/.foundry-cache --config-path $PWD/contracts/foundry.toml; fi
